Children’s Dentistry18 Jul, 2023

What to Expect During Your First Dental Visit

A first visit is a chance for your child to meet the dental team, explore the room, and get comfortable at their own pace.

Read article

Before the appointment, talk about the visit in a calm, positive way. Let the clinic know about any worries or sensory needs so the team can help your child feel at ease.

The dentist will usually ask about your child’s health, check their teeth and gums, and explain what they see. The visit can be adapted to your child’s age and comfort.

Questions are welcome. Your dental team can suggest simple ways to make brushing and future visits easier at home.

Oral Health18 Jul, 2023

When to See a Dentist About Tooth Pain

Learn what to notice and when it’s a good idea to get professional advice about tooth discomfort.

Read article

Tooth pain can have many causes. Contact a dentist if pain persists, returns, or affects eating or sleeping. A prompt assessment can help identify what is causing it.

Seek urgent dental advice for severe pain, facial swelling, fever, or an injury to a tooth. If you have difficulty breathing or swallowing, seek emergency medical care.

What to Know Before Getting Braces

Braces can help align your smile. Learn what to expect and how to care for your teeth throughout treatment.

Read article

Your orthodontist will explain your treatment plan and how to care for your braces during treatment.

Brush carefully around brackets and wires, and use the cleaning tools recommended by your dental team to reach between them.
